slides.heading: Turn meeting notes into action items
slides.body: An illustrative example of a structured task you can ask an AI assistant to help with.

slides.heading: Give it clear rules
slides.body: Ask for a table of tasks, owners, and due dates. Instruct it to mark missing details instead of guessing.

slides.heading: Check before sharing
slides.body: Compare each row with the original notes. Use fictional or non-sensitive information when testing.

caption: An illustrative prompt idea: make a table of tasks, owners, and dates from your meeting notes. Check the result against the original notes. This is not a recorded test.
